name: Ticking
description: Mattress ticking: every column a broad stripe of its own color and width between two pinlines, with a hairline of another color dividing the columns.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @pd(@m(@X, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)))); --w: @pd(@m(@X, @p(12%, 22%, 32%))); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color5) 0 1%, transparent 1% 99%, var(--color5) 99%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: @var(--w); background-color: @p(@var(--t)); -webkit-transform: translateX(-50%); transform: translateX(-50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--t); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 19%, #000 19% 23%, transparent 23%, transparent 77%, #000 77% 81%, transparent 81%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 19%, #000 19% 23%, transparent 23%, transparent 77%, #000 77% 81%, transparent 81%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
